Course Outcomes

Part B 
Modules Contents Pedagogy Hours 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
1 
 
Introduction to Deep Learning and Neural 
Networks: 
Introduction to AI, ML and Deep Learning, 
Historical Trends in Deep Learning, 
Applications of Deep Learning, Artificial 
Neural Networks, Biological and Artificial 
Neurons, Perceptron, Single and Multi Layer 
Perceptron, Feed Forward Neural Networks, 
Activation Functions – Sigmoid, Tanh, ReLU 
and Softmax, Gradient Descent, 
Backpropagation, Overfitting and Underfitting, 
Introduction to TensorFlow, Keras and 
PyTorch. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Lecture and Hands-On 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
5 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
2 
 
CONVOLUTIONAL NEURAL NETWORKS 
(CNN) 
 
Introduction to Computer Vision, CNN 
Architecture, Convolution Operation, Feature 
Maps, Filters, Stride and Padding, Pooling 
Layers, Fully Connected Layers, Dropout 
and Batch Normalization, Data 
Augmentation, Transfer Learning, Popular 
CNN Architectures – LeNet, AlexNet, 
VGGNet, ResNet, Vision Transformers (ViT),  
Introduction to Object Detection and Image 
Segmentation, Applications of CNNs. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Lecture and Hands-On 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
7 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
3 
 
RECURRENT NEURAL NETWORKS (RNN) 
AND TRANSFORMERS 
 
Introduction to Sequential Data and NLP, 
Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), 
Backpropagation Through Time (BPTT), 
Vanishing Gradient Problem, Long Short-
Term Memory (LSTM), Gated Recurrent 
Unit (GRU), Bidirectional RNN and LSTM, 
Attention Mechanism, Introduction to 
Transformers, Self-Attention, Prompt 
Engineering , Basics of BERT and GPT 
Models, Applications in Text Classification, 
Language Translation and Chatbots. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Lecture and Hands-On 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
7 
4 GENERATIVE AI AND GANs 
 
Generative and Discriminative Models, 
Introduction to Generative AI, Generative 
Adversarial Networks (GANs), Generator 
and Discriminator Networks, Types of 
GANs – DCGAN and Conditional GAN, 
Applications of GANs, Autoencoders, 
Encoder and Decoder Architecture, 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Lecture and Hands-On 
6 
. 
3/4 
 
 
Variational Autoencoders (VAE), 
Relationship between Autoencoders and 
GANs, Introduction to Diffusion Models and 
AI Image Generation. 
5 DEEP LEARNING APPLICATIONS 
 
Model Evaluation Metrics – Accuracy, 
Precision, Recall, F1-Score and Confusion 
Matrix, Hyperparameter Tuning, Explainable 
AI (XAI), Transfer Learning and Fine Tuning, 
Ethical Issues in AI, Emerging Trends – 
Multimodal AI, Federated Learning and AI 
Agents, Applications in Healthcare, 
Agriculture, Cybersecurity and Robotics. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Lecture and Hands-On
